title: Workspace candidate reranking
description: The reranker's output and the composition's input: which of the products a search returned answer each component's need, in the order they answer it best. It carries NO WORKSPACE, NO TOTAL and NO SLOT, because a product is not a workspace and the slot belongs to the search that returned it. Every one of the seven categories is always present; an empty list is a judgement that none of the products answer that component.

componentAssessment.description: This component's products, most relevant first. The order is the ranking.

sku.description: A SKU from the products this component was given, exactly as it was written. A SKU that was not given is dropped.

relevance.description: How directly the product answers this component's need.

reason.description: One clause about the need, in the composer's terms. Never a price, a product name or the customer's sentence.
